secrets.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs session cookies. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

secrets.name: ALLOWED_SIGN_IN
secrets.description: The only authorization list. Comma-separated email domains or single addresses, for example acme.com or you@gmail.com

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client id. It is the sign-in button and the Gmail/Calendar sync. Create it at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Google OAuth client secret for the same client. Set it together with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
